newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Tellus state shares change hands.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Tellus state shares change hands.

text.p: Shenzhen Tellus Holdings Co Ltd on Wednesday announced the sale of its state shares, amounting to 72.4 percent of its equity, to a state-owned company based in Shenzhen.

Tellus said in a statement that Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Development (Group) Co has bought 159.59 million state shares, accounting for 72.4 percent of Tellus' total outstanding shares, from Shenzhen Investment & Management Co.
The statement gave no further details.

Shenzhen Development is a strong state-owned company and Shenzhen Investment is under the Shenzhen municipal government, a Tellus official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
